cold_report.common_boot_args: console=ttyS0,115200 nokaslr rdinit=/init quiet loglevel=3 8250.nr_uarts=1 i8042.noaux i8042.nomux i8042.nopnp i8042.dumbkbd
limitations: Shared nested-KVM host; no dedicated hardware
Persistent HyperMachine HTTP daemon versus fresh Firecracker processes and Unix APIs
Barrier-released arrivals have measured scheduling spread; not sustained arrivals
All guests held until last validation; earlier guests have longer idle time
Aggregate process PSS includes guest/VMM memory but excludes kernel allocations; no long idle/density test
Cold native engines only; no managed SDK, snapshot or fleet comparison
Fixed idle hold starts after all readiness checks; individual guest idle ages and sequential read duration are recorded; PSS excludes kernel memory and does not prove density
cold_report.memory_method: HM held daemon minus same-batch empty daemon PSS; FC summed fresh VMM PSS minus zero-process baseline
cold_report.node_log_tail:
hv2-sandboxd: listening on 0.0.0.0:37725, capacity 128
  POST   /sandboxes                -- E2B-shaped (NewSandbox -> Sandbox), boots a real VM and its own process.Process gRPC listener (port in the response's processPort)
  POST   /sandboxes/{id}/exec     -- NOT E2B's envd protocol; a real exec_in_guest (simpler than grpcurl-ing processPort)
  POST   /sandboxes/{id}/connect  -- attach to an existing sandbox; what the E2B SDK's Sandbox.connect() calls
  DELETE /sandboxes/{id}          -- stop the VM and its process.Process listener
  PUT    /sandboxes/{id}/network  -- replace a running sandbox's egress rules
  POST   /sandboxes/{id}/pause    -- suspend to disk; connect or resume brings it back,          and with autoResume so does a request through the proxy
  POST   /sandboxes/{id}/fork     -- checkpoint in place, start `count` copies
  GET    /sandboxes/{id}/network/decisions -- NOT E2B's; the gateway's audit log
sandboxes get no network interface (--network to change that)
sandboxes boot from the kernel (no template snapshot)

sandbox proxy on 0.0.0.0:56617 -- HTTP/2, routed by the authority a client asks for, as 49983-<sandboxID>.<anything>
  grpcurl -plaintext -authority 49983-$SBX.local -H "X-Access-Token: $TOKEN" -import-path crates/hv2-api/proto -proto process.proto \
      -d '{"process":{"cmd":"/bin/sh","args":["-c","echo hi"]}}' \
      localhost:56617 process.Process/Start
